notes: The skill adds ~56 percentage points to the pass rate (100% vs 44%).
The with-skill runs are consistently slower (~53s more) and use ~5K more tokens due to design doc and review workflow overhead.

All baseline runs pass the implementation-quality assertions (serde usage, TTL logic, edge cases, tests). The skill's value-add is entirely in process artifacts: design docs, branch conventions, and review checklists.
The 3 assertions that discriminate between with-skill and without-skill are: design_doc_exists, design_doc_has_sections, and review_checklist_applied. These are the workflow-process assertions.
Implementation quality (code correctness, test coverage) is comparable between with-skill and without-skill runs.
